lead.title: Corpus-layer input: allow-listed reader, loose schemas, corpus-policy config, visible set
lead.brief: Read first: docs/sites/corpus-wave-plan.md §1 (rules), §2 (defaults), §3.1 (input rules); docs/corpus-data.md in full, especially 'Publishing rules'; src/corpus-types.ts (import relatively, read-only); docs/sites/concept-quiet-corpus.md C6 'No transcript' table and C8.1/C8.4; docs/sites/concept-live-corpus.md F.2, F.3, E.1 first paragraph. Deliverables: (1) extend DATA_ALLOW_LIST with exact patterns for data/derived/corpus/{index,topics,concepts,people,works,stories,teaching-clusters,redirects}.json, series/<id>.json and shiur-tags/<shiurId>.json ONLY. Add a deny rule checked before the allow-list so that anything under derived/corpus/raw/, any *alias-map*, *asr*, *heard* or *variant* name, topic-tags/, teaching-clusters/ (the directory), and search/sections.jsonl throws ForbiddenPathError even if a later pattern would match. (2) Loose valibot schemas for each file. Required fields are the ones the sites render. Unknown fields are ignored and never copied. Read optionally: reviewStatus, sameAs, otherSpeakerShare, mergedInto, kind (work/story), parsha/zman (topic), private/family/contemporary flags (person). A key named asrVariants or heardAs* is dropped on read and counted in the report, so a future reversal upstream cannot leak it. (3) Failure policy: corpus dir absent → fatal (the corpus layer is required). index.json version not in KNOWN_CORPUS_VERSIONS → warning (policy unknownVersion: 'warn' | 'fail'). A core file (topics/concepts/people/works) present but failing required shape → fatal, like invalid ingest. An optional file (stories, teaching-clusters, series/*, redirects, a shiur-tags file) missing or invalid → that feature off or that shiur untagged, with a report entry. A single invalid record → dropped and reported. index.json `files` entries that the reader does not know are listed in the report as 'not read' (names only). (4) site-policy/corpus-policy.json: schema, loader and defaults in code (missing file = defaults; invalid = fatal). The file ships with the defaults from plan §2. Add it to POLICY_ALLOW_LIST and document it in site-policy/README.md. (5) Visible-set model (plan §3.2): V = .corpus status 'full' ∩ corpus index.shiurIds. Member visibility = shiur in V, plus the referenced extraction item survived projection (the moment id exists in PublicShiur), plus, for stories and threads when policy.visibility.followCategoryVisibility is set, the shiur's category has generalBrowse true in publish-policy. (6) Mini fixture: make-mini-corpus.ts slices the real corpus layer down to the mini corpus's done shiurim. Add synthetic cases: a topics[].sameAs, a redirects.json chain (a→b→c) and a cycle, a mergedInto on a record, a work `kind`, a story telling and a cluster member in a not-done shiur, a cluster member whose insight is below the confidence threshold, an `other` person with 1 shiur, a person named "the Mashgiach's father", an index.json with an unknown file name, and a poisoned raw/ directory and *-alias-map.json, which the reader must never open.
lead.acceptance: A test proves the reader throws for every path under data/derived/corpus/raw/, for each alias-map name, for asr-variants.json and for search/sections.jsonl. A test proves a full layer read of the real data/ opens only allow-listed files (reader spy). Schema tests: unknown fields are ignored, asrVariants is dropped and counted, an unknown version warns, a missing stories.json disables stories only, a broken topics.json is fatal. The policy loader round-trips the default file. The visible-set unit tests cover needs_review, downgraded, simcha/current and confidence-dropped members. Unit tests for everything listed are added under the package's own paths; `npm run site:typecheck`, `npm run site:lint` and `npm run site:test` pass in the worktree; `git diff` shows no change under data/, scripts/, src/, config/ or prompts/; no package-lock.json change (new deps listed in the workspace's own package.json only).

lead.title: Corpus-layer projection: .corpus/layer/ entity files, per-shiur refs, recounts, page flags, redirects, synonyms
paths: packages/corpus/src/aggregate/** (additive: workId on works, occasion→topic map; keep legacy files)
lead.brief: Read first: docs/sites/corpus-wave-plan.md §3 (contract), §2 (defaults); docs/sites/concept-quiet-corpus.md C3, C4.1–C4.8, C6 'Who gets a page' and 'Filters'; docs/sites/concept-live-corpus.md B, C.1–C.6, E.1, E.2, E.5, G (every page file is self-contained). Deliverables: buildCorpusWithAggregates also writes .corpus/layer/ (plan §3.3). The files are layer.json, topics.json (tree + per-topic detail), concepts.json, people.json, works.json, stories.json, threads.json, series/<id>.json, shiur/<shiurId>.json (per-shiur refs), synonyms.json, redirects.json, occasion-topics.json. Every file is built by copying allow-listed fields one by one; there is no spread of raw records. Counts and page flags are recomputed from the visible set (never shiurCount or shiurIds.length). The two sites' thresholds come from corpus-policy (Quiet C6 table, Live E.1 table). Every entity carries reviewed: boolean. Topics: three grades per topic (salience ≥0.6 / lower / section-only, with section idx). Section tags on other_speaker chapters are dropped. Hubs are re-filtered to V, exclude otherSpeakerShare ≥ policy.featured.maxOtherSpeakerShare and are refilled by salience. Also: children, co-tagged topics (section co-tagging), threads whose topicIds include the topic, and stories with a telling inside a tagged section (timestamp join). sameAs is read from topics[].sameAs (no slug matching): concept sameAs → concept marked mergedIntoTopic; person and work sameAs → cross-link only. Concepts: passim flag above policy fraction (Quiet 1/7) and the Live facet-drop flag (>1/4). exampleRefs are filtered to visible chapters. People: type groups; listing and page flags per site follow policy (type other: no page; Quiet line only from 3 shiurim; Live none). Family exclusion is derived from the entity's own fields, never a hand list: nameEn/aliases matching policy.people.familyPattern (default \bthe Mashgiach'?s\b), or optional private/family flags, or policy.people.excludeIds (empty by default). Works: generic flag from optional Work.kind, falling back to the @emunas/normalize works-table genre flag matched through the work's own display names. Order group from that table, unknown works last. Stories: visible tellings with the chapter each telling sits in. Unresolved raw names stay plain strings with linked:false. Threads (teaching clusters): visible members with year and lang. Clusters left with <2 shiurim are dropped. Pages need ≥3 distinct shiurim. Two-member clusters only produce an inline pointer in each member's shiur refs. Series: synthesis only for series with ≥1 visible part; arc filtered to V, plus the list of non-visible parts. Per-shiur refs: topics with salience, chapter topicIds, concept/person/work ids, sourceWorkIds keyed by source moment id, story ids per story moment (with visible-telling count and page flag), thread id per insight moment (count, year span, page flag, or the inline pointer). synonyms.json: per entity, only its own display fields (aliases, transliterations, canonicalHe, labels, names, titles, topic aliases), folded and deduplicated. redirects.json: (a) corpus redirects from data redirects.json plus record-level mergedInto, chains resolved, cycles and dangling targets reported and dropped. (b) legacy keys: the old normalize-keyed person/work/concept entities (still computed by the current aggregate) mapped to new ids. Matching is folded spelling vs the new entity's display names, then the same slug, then (people only) ≥80% shiur overlap; a match finally follows (a). Unmatched → null (the site sends it to the index page). occasion-topics.json: an optional topic parsha/zman field when present, else derived. The derived rule takes the level-2/3 topic with the highest share of the occasion's catalog shiurim at salience ≥0.6, if the share is ≥ policy.occasionTopic.minShare (default 0.5); otherwise none. Aggregate works.json gains workId per entry (the reference-order layout stays). Legacy people/concepts/stories/entities files and SeriesEntry.sibling are kept unchanged in this wave; C3.1 removes them. A report-only lint lists cluster summaries whose prose states a number of shiurim that disagrees with the visible count (pending upstream fix, Quiet C8.3). Public types for every layer file go in @emunas/corpus/public (corpus-layer.ts). Bump a separate LAYER_SCHEMA_VERSION, not SCHEMA_VERSION, so shiur fingerprints do not churn.
lead.acceptance: Golden tests on the mini fixture for every layer file. On real data: (1) no topic/entity count exceeds the visible recount, and none references a shiur outside V; (2) the needs_review shiurim appear in no layer file; (3) 78 sameAs topics resolve, and no concept page exists for a concept merged into a topic; (4) the stories redirect the-sanzer-rav-and-the-business-competitor → the-divrei-chaim-and-the-man-who-shamed is resolved; (5) a property test: every alias/synonym published in synonyms.json and in every layer file is a member of its entity's display-field set read from data/derived/corpus/*.json; (6) no layer file contains the keys asrVariants, heardAs*, startSeg, endSeg; (7) shabbos-tefilah-en has no series synthesis output; (8) layer build adds < 10 s to corpus:build; (9) a rerun with unchanged input rewrites no file; (10) the existing .corpus outputs other than works.json are byte-identical to before the change. Unit tests for everything listed are added under the package's own paths; `npm run site:typecheck`, `npm run site:lint` and `npm run site:test` pass in the worktree; `git diff` shows no change under data/, scripts/, src/, config/ or prompts/; no package-lock.json change (new deps listed in the workspace's own package.json only).

lead.title: Leak guard for the corpus layer: forbidden keys, raw/ ban, alias-key assertion, verbatim scan of corpus text, corpus suppress ids
lead.brief: Read first: docs/sites/corpus-wave-plan.md §1 rules 1–3, §3.4; docs/sites/integration-plan.md §0, §5.3; docs/corpus-data.md 'Publishing rules'; docs/sites/concept-quiet-corpus.md C6 'No transcript'; docs/sites/concept-live-corpus.md F.2; packages/corpus-guard/README.md. Deliverables: (1) FORBIDDEN_KEYS += asrVariants, heardAsSamples, sampleTitles, resolutionTotals, nullWork, fromStories, fromPeople (raw-only keys). DISTINCTIVE_KEYS += asrVariants, heardAsSamples. FORBIDDEN_SUBSTRINGS += 'corpus/raw/', 'alias-map', 'asr-variants'. (2) Raw-ban check: only this package may read data/derived/corpus/raw/asr-variants.json (add the literal to the ESLint restricted list with the same exemption as data/transcripts). Post-pass: every string in an alias-bearing position (JSON keys aliases, synonyms, transliterations, names, terms; .corpus/layer/synonyms.json; search EntityDoc synonym fields; Pagefind entity-record synonym meta; the Live quick index alias field) that folds equal to an ASR variant and is not also a display name of that entity is a finding. (3) Alias-key assertion: for every (kind, id, term) published in synonyms.json, entity docs and layer files, the term must be in the entity's display-field set, read independently from data/derived/corpus/{topics,concepts,people,works}.json (not from .corpus). Otherwise it is a finding. (4) Verbatim: new unit reader for .corpus/layer/ text units, with item ids corpus:<kind>:<id>#<field>.<lang>. Fields: story title+retelling, thread label+summary, topic description, concept label+definition, series title/overview/keyThemes/arc oneLiners. Pre-pass compares each unit with the transcripts of all its member shiurim (tellings, members, arc, hubs, exampleRefs + shiurIds); post-pass uses member attribution in JSON and the whole-corpus shingle index for HTML. Thresholds stay 12/20. suppress.json gains corpus item ids. packages/corpus/src/layer/suppress.ts applies them on corpus:build --suppress: blank that field (entity kept, page shows the label without the text) and report it. verbatim-allow.json accepts corpus item ids. (5) Reports keep holding ids, field paths and counts only. (6) README: new checks and item-id table.
lead.acceptance: Fixture tests: a planted asrVariants key fails post; a planted string from the fixture's raw/asr-variants.json inside a synonyms list fails post; a synonym that is not a display field fails post; a synthetic transcript with a 20-token run planted in a fixture story retelling lands in suppress.json as corpus:story:<id>#retelling.en, and the rebuild with --suppress blanks only that field; an 11-token run passes; the report greps clean of the synthetic sentence; an ESLint test proves an apps/ file containing 'corpus/raw' fails lint. Real data: the pre-pass over .corpus including layer units runs in < 3 min and prints counts. Unit tests for everything listed are added under the package's own paths; `npm run site:typecheck`, `npm run site:lint` and `npm run site:test` pass in the worktree; `git diff` shows no change under data/, scripts/, src/, config/ or prompts/; no package-lock.json change (new deps listed in the workspace's own package.json only).

lead.title: URL scheme and shared vocabulary: @emunas/links routes for topics, glossary, stories, threads; legacy paths; i18n corpus labels
lead.brief: Read first: docs/sites/corpus-wave-plan.md §3.5 (URL table), §2 (defaults: thread pages noindex); docs/sites/integration-plan.md §2.2–2.3; docs/sites/concept-quiet-corpus.md C5 (addresses, ענינים→ערכים rename, redirects), C6 'The label'; docs/sites/concept-live-corpus.md E.3, F.3, B 'Answer to the replace question'. Deliverables: (1) Route kinds topic, glossary entry (concept), story, thread; index names topics, glossary. Quiet: /{ed}/inyanim/ and /{ed}/inyanim/{topicId}/ (+ all/ continuation), /{ed}/erachim/ and /{ed}/erachim/{conceptId}/, /{ed}/stories/{storyId}/, people/sources unchanged in shape, /{ed}/people/{id}/all/. Live: /{ui}/t/{topicId}, /{ui}/th/{threadId}, /{ui}/maasios/{storyId}, /{ui}/c/{conceptId}, /{ui}/p, /{ui}/seforim unchanged. (2) equivalent(): topic↔topic, concept↔concept (Live concept merged into a topic → topic), story↔story, thread → Quiet edition home #indexes (no Quiet page in this cut). LinkData gains hasPage(site, kind, id) read from layer page flags. Below-threshold entities resolve to the index anchor on Quiet and to null (no link) on Live. canonicalFor: Live topic/story/person/work/concept → Quiet page when hasPage('quiet'), else no canonical and the page marked noindex (helper noindexFor). Thread pages are always noindex in this cut. (3) legacyPaths(site, kind, oldKey) for the old Quiet /people/, /sources/, /inyanim/{conceptKey}/ and Live /p/, /c/, /seforim/ (+ chapter) addresses. Note: an old Quiet /inyanim/{conceptKey}/ whose key equals a topic id now IS that topic page (one inyan, one entry: Quiet C4.1.6) and needs no redirect. (4) i18n vocab (en/yi), shared by both sites: the corpus AI-label sentences (Quiet C6 'The label' wording, Live E.3 wording, and the reviewed variants), person type group names in sefer order, topic grade names, 'retold from N tellings', 'told in N other shiurim', 'also taught in', 'throughout', 'notes not prepared yet', the report-entry wording. Yiddish uses 'דער משגיח' for the Mashgiach.
lead.acceptance: Round-trip tests for every new route in both editions; equivalent(quiet→live→quiet) is identity for topic/concept/story; a merged concept maps to its topic; canonicalFor never returns a analyze.* URL and returns null for threads; legacyPaths covers every old route shape; purity test still passes (no Node/DOM); i18n type test: every new key exists in en and yi. lead.title: @emunas/search-core on the corpus layer: topic keywords, corpus-id facets, EntityDoc, clean synonyms in normalizeQuery
lead.brief: Read first: docs/sites/corpus-wave-plan.md §1 rule 1, §3.6; docs/sites/concept-quiet-corpus.md C3 (candidateTopics replaced), C5 'Search'; docs/sites/concept-live-corpus.md D 'Search and the command bar', F.2 'ASR variants for search'; packages/search-core/README.md. Deliverables: (1) SearchDoc.keywords = the shiur's visible topic labels (en/yi/he) + topic aliases from .corpus/layer (low weight, never displayed). loadCandidateTopics and every read of extraction candidateTopics are removed (C9 retired). (2) DocFacets/MomentRow entities switch to corpus ids from .corpus/layer/shiur/<id>.json and add topics (section rows: the chapter's topicIds; other rows: shiur topics with salience ≥0.6). Add 'topics' to the allow-lists and to the type assertions. (3) EntityDoc (.corpus/search/entities.ndjson): kind topic|concept|person|work, id, labels, synonyms (from layer synonyms.json only), visible count, page flags. Only entities listed on at least one site, never type-other people. Story and thread docs are second cut, so leave them out. (6) The leak test runs the C1.3 guard, including the alias-key assertion, over docs/moments/entities NDJSON. Keep buildSearchDoc's existing call signature working (new inputs optional), so the Live emitter compiles unchanged until C1.7 adopts it.
